newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX trades at lower levels mid-bourse.
newsitem.headline: German DAX trades at lower levels mid-bourse.

text.p: 0949 GMT - German DAX index continues to trade lower in mid-session bourse, sentiment hit by worries about future of EMU after Bundesbank/Bonn clash over gold reserve revaluation. Possible victory for left in Sunday's French elections adds to gloom. Lower Wall St close overnight, Bunds weakness add finishing touches to downbeat picture for equities.
* June DAX future at 3,584.5 points, down 53.5.
* Commerzbank down one mark at 50.20 marks, despite upbeat 97 earnings outlook.
* VW lower, says China JV in black for first time.
